test_im_add_ccdc_bands_2d: test im_add_ccdc_bands_2d to pad and add CCDC coefficient bands with shape (num_segments, 8) to an Earth Engine image
test_im_add_ccdc_bands_1d: test im_add_ccdc_bands_1d to pad and add CCDC single-value bands with shape (num_segments,) to an Earth Engine image
test_get_ccdc_pixels: test get_ccdc_pixels to reconstruct flat CCDC pixel dictionaries into (H, W, T, C) numpy arrays using a config
test_generate_ccdc: test generate_ccdc to produce CCDC data in (T, H, W, C) format with optional annual segment extraction and masking
test_generate_ccdc_selection_methods: test generate_ccdc with longest and middle selection methods to pick CCDC segments by duration or midpoint date
